subject: Post-call: Security discovery — evidence timelines, retention, DPA & pen-test asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <security@aperturebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Security discovery — evidence timelines, retention, DPA & pen-test asks

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery so we have a shared checklist and owners. If anything below needs correction, flag it and I’ll update.

Top pain / goals you shared
- Need clear retention guarantees for audit logs (7 years for certain transaction classes).
- SOC 2 coverage and evidence for access controls and change management.
- Prefer vendors who will sign a DPA with explicit audit-log retention language.
- Want pen-test scope and timeline before procurement sign-off.

What we committed to send (owners & ETA)
1) SOC 2 summary + list of artifacts (Marissa) — EOD Tue 2025-07-21.
2) Sample audit-log export (anonymized CSV) + retention policy doc (Ben) — Wed 2025-07-22.
3) Draft DPA with retention clause we normally use (Laura) — Wed 2025-07-22.
4) Pen-test scoping template + suggested external firms (Ben) — Thu 2025-07-24.

Immediate asks for Aperture
- Confirm the 7-year retention requirement applies to logs for Transaction Class A (yes/no).
- Point of contact for legal to review DPA (name/email).
- Any preferred pen-test vendors or procurement constraints.

Attachments referenced below:
- [Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)]
- [Attachment: audit-log-sample.csv (csv)]
- [Attachment: DPA_draft_v1.docx (docx)]
- [Attachment: pen_test_scope.xlsx (xlsx)]

Next step: I’ll drop the SOC 2 summary now and Ben will share the audit-log sample tomorrow. Happy to set a 30-min follow-up next week to run through the draft DPA if that’s helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ramos <security@aperturebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security discovery — evidence timelines, retention, DPA & pen-test asks

Marissa — thank you for the clear recap. A few clarifications below: 

- Yes, the 7-year retention applies to Transaction Class A logs (financial posting + dispute flows). For other classes 3 years is acceptable.
- Legal lead that will own DPA is Jorge Mendez (jorge.mendez@aperturebank.com). I'll intro him on the thread once we have the draft.
- Procurement has a preferred vendor list for pen tests (see attached list) but we are open if you propose a vendor that meets our controls.

Can you confirm: will the audit-log sample include schema and an explanation of field retention (what we can expect to be redacted/anonymized)? We need to validate that PII fields are removed prior to sharing.

Appreciate the timeline — we’re targeting an internal procurement window in the week of 2025-08-04, so having the DPA & pen-test scope finalized before then would be ideal.

Best,
Elena Ramos
Director, Information Security
Aperture Financial
[Attachment: apertures-procured-penvendors.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: Post-call: Security discovery — evidence timelines, retention, DPA & pen-test asks

Marissa / Laura — quick internal update and proposed artifact handoff. Per Elena’s ask we will scrub PII from the audit-log sample; expected contents: timestamp, event_type, actor_hash, object_id_hash, region, retention_class. No free-text fields.

Where I’ll put artifacts:
- S3 (pre-auth link) -> https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-evidence/aperture/2025-07-22/audit-log-sample.csv (will send after scrub)
- Drive folder for legal -> SOC2_summary.pdf and DPA draft in shared Drive folder (link below).

Proposed timeline updates:
- Audit log sample (scrubbed) -> Wed 2025-07-22 EOD (owner: Ben).
- DPA draft -> Wed 2025-07-22 midday (owner: Laura).
- Pen-test scoping call: propose Thu 2025-07-24 10:00-10:30 PT — I'll include template and two recommended vendors for Aperture procurement.

Notes: we should include a short section in the DPA that maps retention classes to log fields (so legal doesn't need to chase technical). I’ll pull a template snippet we use for other financial customers.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147
